core_obligations: Setup: surjectivity of Mor_S(lim T_i, X) -> colim Mor_S(T_i, X) alone; reduce to affine opens U of X and V of the limit.
Image lifting: a morphism from an affine open of the limit into X lifts to some finite level by the surjectivity hypothesis on the affine pieces.
Contradiction close: if U misses the image of the limit point, the closed-nonempty lemma produces a point of the limit outside U; conclude (2)=>(1).
proof_roadmap: Lift affine pieces via the surjectivity hypothesis.
difficulty_reason: Self-contained re-run of the (2)=>(1) argument with only a surjectivity hypothesis: affine reduction, image lifting, closed-nonempty contradiction. The full argument is repeated in span, not outsourced.

compared.difference: The proposition proves the full Mor identity; this lemma weakens the hypothesis to surjectivity only and re-proves the needed direction in full. Different (weaker-hypothesis) statement delivered separately (L30197).
